name: Sonnet
description: A gentle, sweet-natured Blenheim girl with a rich chestnut coat and the classic white blaze. Sonnet is the first to greet visitors and adores being held. Raised underfoot in our home and started on early neurological stimulation.

name: Baxter
description: A striking tricolour boy with bold markings and a playful, confident personality. Baxter loves a good game of fetch and settles quickly for a nap. Reserved for a wonderful family in Columbus.

name: Marigold
description: A radiant ruby girl with a warm, even coat and soulful eyes. Marigold is calm, affectionate and wonderful with children. Vet-checked, first vaccinations complete and ready for her forever home.

name: Percy
description: A handsome black & tan boy with glossy feathering and rich tan points. Percy is devoted and eager to please. He has joined his forever family and is thriving.
